title: AP Catchup Protocol Watermark
description: One JSON file per SourceType under memory/ap_catchup/<source>.json. Records the bot's last-known checkpoint so a restart / outage doesn't double-process events. Sprint 2 wires the read side; Sprint 3 wires active replay.

source.description: Watermark source type; one file per source.

value.description: Opaque checkpoint — Discord message_id / ISO timestamp / Notion page_id depending on source.

extra.description: Source-specific metadata (e.g., per-channel breakdown for discord_feedback)
